reason.why_exclusion_is_required: The ontology names ASIA, LONDON, NEW_YORK and LONDON_NY_OVERLAP but does not define exact civil-market opening/closing boundaries, inclusivity, holiday handling, or overlap construction. Multiple public conventions exist. Choosing one now would create a new discretionary degree of freedom before development results and would not be a recovery of the frozen ontology.

reopen_rule: A future session descendant may be created only by a new preregistration that freezes exact civil timezones, local start/end times, inclusivity, DST libraries/version, holiday treatment and server-to-UTC conversion before any economic result. It is not the same frozen G30 branch cell and cannot retroactively alter this exclusion.
